meta.title: Trust in local government
meta.question: How much do Poles trust local government?
meta.measure: Average trust in local government, from 0 (no trust at all) to 10 (complete trust)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on trust or confidence in local government and local authorities, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: To what degree do you trust the local authorities (town, gmina)? (1 complete trust ... 5 complete lack of trust)
items.notes: CBOS, 2000-11 (APiW 126), 1 survey. 'Do jakiego stopnia darzy Pan(i) zaufaniem', 1 = complete trust ... 5 = complete lack of trust.
PGSW 2001 and 2005. 'Trust very much / rather trust / rather distrust / completely distrust'. Councillors as people rather than local government as an institution.

items.wording: Do you, generally speaking, trust the local authorities of your town or gmina? (definitely ... definitely not)
items.notes: CBOS, 2002-01, 2004-01, 2006-01, 2008-01, 2010-01, 2012-01, 2014-01, 2014-03, 2016-01 (9 surveys). CBOS biennial trust battery ('Czy, ogólnie rzecz biorąc, ma Pan(i) zaufanie, czy też nie ma Pan(i) zaufania, do ...'), four answers plus 'trudno powiedzieć'. Labels vary: '... - X' (2002, 2004, 2010-16), 'zaufanie do K) X' (2006-01), 'zaufanie do X' (2008-01). In 2014 the battery was split across APiW 284 (January) and 286 (March). Asked in both 2014 halves of the battery.

items.wording: Do you have trust in the local authorities? (definitely yes ... definitely no)
items.notes: CBOS, 2006-12 (APiW 199), 1 survey. One-off CBOS trust questions answered 'zdecydowanie tak ... zdecydowanie nie' (not the 'mam zaufanie' battery).

items.wording: Do you tend to trust or not to trust regional or local public authorities?
items.notes: Standard/EP Eurobarometer, 2008-2026, 33 surveys. 'Tend to trust / tend not to trust', DK outside the scale. The object is regional or local authorities together; five label spellings.
